fields.accepted_completed_line_count: count of visible complete DSL lines
fields.declared_action_count: count from the visible actions line
fields.declared_state_count: count from the visible states line
fields.error_reason: structured parser error when status is rejected
fields.expected_next: visible grammar symbols that can extend the prefix
fields.missing_state_actions: declared states that do not yet have rules
fields.phase: coarse syntactic phase from visible DSL text
fields.prefix_sha256: hash of the bytes supplied to the parser
fields.rule_count: count of visible complete rule lines
